messages:
maria: FYI - Nina from PartnerCo just confirmed a failing workload on their managed instances after the latest driver push (535.110). They see CUDA driver hangs for long attention windows. Need quick alignment on pinning + hotfix cadence.

sahil: thanks. can we get exact kernel/OS + repro size? PartnerCo said it fails at ~6k tokens on p4d-ish hardware?

nina-partner: correct — their internal SI runs a multi-document summarization job ~6-7k tokens. stack: Ubuntu 22.04, kernel 5.19, driver 535.110, CUDA 12.1. Repro attached to ticket PC-1127.

kevin: if it's driver-specific we should publish a marketplace image with a pinned, known-good driver (534.x) and mark 535.x as "experimental" until we validate. We also need a hotfix path for partners who already upgraded.

maria: agree. propose three lanes: 1) pin marketplace images to 534.98 by default; 2) experimental tag for 535.* used only for internal beta; 3) hotfix bundle for partners with automated rollback.

eng-partner: partner engineering wants an easy toggle - ideally a parameter in the marketplace launch config to choose driver_pin. their customers manage via AMI options.

ops-bot: Action created: PARTNER-8723. Canary plan templated.

kevin: temp config snippet we can include in marketplace docs:

```yaml
image: redwood/inference:marketplace-2026-03
driver_pin: 534.98    # stable
experimental_driver: 535.110
hotfix_rollforward: true
```

jen: (cc @sahil) we should add a validation test in our preflight that runs a 7k token long-context prompt through the image and checks for GPU hangs > 20s. add to CI for marketplace release.

sahil: i'll add a preflight job and a rollback lambda. lambda will toggle image tag and notify partner slack channel + marketplace portal. threshold: >=2 hangs within 15m -> rollback.

maria: partner comms: do we plan a joint advisory or opt for quiet rollback + postmortem? Nina, what's PartnerCo preference?

nina-partner: prefer short advisory to customers who might be affected. we'll coordinate wording. target: internal advisory + joint KB tomorrow morning.

kevin: timeline: today - cut pinned marketplace image and update docs; tomorrow - run partner canary (1-2% traffic) and run preflight tests; if green, mark experimental_driver as safe for beta. If not, push hotfix and rollback.

eng-partner: also request we attach kernel oops logs and modprobe traces to the ticket so SI teams can triage.

ops-bot: Canary deployment initiated: group=partnerco-535-experiment percent=1 image=redwood/inference:marketplace-2026-03 driver=535.110

sahil: wiring alert: monitor gpu_hang_count and nvml_gpu_reset metrics. rollback rule: gpu_hang_rate > 0.01 sustained for 10m -> trigger PARTNER-8723 rollback.

maria: final checklist in thread:
- cut pinned image (534.98) and update marketplace docs (kevin)
- preflight long-context test in CI (sahil)
- canary with PartnerCo 1% tomorrow (kevin + nina-partner)
- rollback lambda + alert (sahil)
- joint customer advisory draft (nina-partner + maria)
- attach kernel logs to PC-1127 (eng-partner)

Please update here with links when ready. :memo:
